title: Equinix Tops Out Its Second Data Center in Johor
excerpts: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia, November 11, 2025 - Equinix, Inc. (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world’s digital infrastructure company®, marked a key construction milestone with the topping out of its second International Business Exchange™ (IBX®) data center in Johor, JH2. With an initial investment of US$201 million, the facility is expected to launch and provide 2,225 cabinets in Q3 2027, supporting Malaysia’s fast-growing economy.
